notes: RBox expansion, functionality, paired with mathematics-replace-0018 (which makes 'has successor' not functional). The made-up relation 'has Calder mate' relates whole numbers to numbers; unlike the real 'has successor' nothing says a number has exactly one, so only the inserted property gives uniqueness. The same property as insert 0017, on whole numbers instead of functions, because the paired revisions 0011 and 0018 both change functionality. Every original answer is null. Yes and no are balanced through phrasing: the first instance asks whether the two mates could differ (no), the second whether they must coincide (yes); the cross-lingual queries ask the first instance. The instance values are letters, so no arithmetic gives the conclusion. The propositional negation asks the opposite of the edit ('can have two different Calder mates'), answer no after the edit. Side facts (a hexagon) are copied from the paired revision. Near unrelated is a real many-valued slot (prime factors), whose answer yes would turn to no if functionality leaked. hops counts the instance facts in the prompt as the bridge (1 + 1).
